p.heroes-dawn.desc: A tactical management RPG in a world where humans have become metahumans: board exploration, combat on a timeline, squad building and headquarters management.
h.feat.sub: A tactical management RPG in a world where humans have become metahumans.
h.feat.text: Lead a squad of metahumans: explore a board that unfolds as you advance, combine your agents' powers on the combat timeline and run The Dawn's headquarters between missions.
h.pillars.title: Read every turn. Plan every mission.
h.p1.d: Every action has a cost and a place on the timeline. Interrupt, parry and combine skills — and see your enemies' next move before they make it.
h.p2.d: Roll the dice and choose your path across each zone: fights, resources, events and objectives, under a time budget that forces real choices.
h.p3.d: Between missions, manage your agents, your grimoire of skill cards, equipment and quests. Every upgrade changes how your squad plays.

hd.about.title: A squad. A world that has changed. One choice at a time.
hd.about.p1: Five years after the Paris Supernova, humans have become metahumans: powers awaken and the world is torn between fear, fascination and hope. Join The Dawn, an organization protecting metahumans and civilians in the Apex Universe, prepare your squad and use your agents' powers to overcome every obstacle.
hd.about.p2: Every mission begins with a choice: pick your route across the board, recruit the right agents and prepare your next outing at headquarters. Heroes Dawn is out on January 15, 2027 on Android, iOS and Steam.
hd.f1.d: Follow the combat timeline, manage your agents' energy and play their skill cards. Strike, protect or support: every decision shapes the balance of your squad.
hd.f2.d: Roll the die to gain movement points, study the available paths and choose your destination. The fog hides what comes next: push forward to uncover encounters, battles and objectives.
hd.f3.d: Recruit agents with different abilities, assemble your team and look for synergies between its members. Prepare their skills and equipment to shape your strategy.
hd.f4.d: Between missions, manage your team, review objectives, craft equipment and organize expeditions. Preparation is part of the adventure.
hd.f5.t: A campaign that starts in New York
hd.f5.d: Choose your mission on the map, follow the objectives of each zone and unlock the next ones as the campaign advances.
hd.f6.d: Rhythm, infiltration, engineering and survival challenges break up the missions and reward the squad.

hd.tech.title: Built to last.
hd.tech.p: Heroes Dawn is built in Unity 6 with a layered clean architecture: an MVP interface, a pure-C# domain package, dependency injection and EditMode / PlayMode tests. In-editor tools let the team author items, skills, agents and narration, and balance the game from spreadsheets.

s.title: Games designed around the player's choices.
s.lead: STUDIO N29 is an independent studio. We start from the experience we want players to live, then shape every system, every screen and every world around it.
s.v1.d: A mechanic is finished when it feels right in the hands, not when it compiles.
s.v2.d: Clean architecture and tools so a whole team can pick a project up and extend it.
s.v3.d: Prototype fast, iterate often and keep the game playable at every step.
s.apex.title: One universe, many games.
s.apex.p1: The Apex Universe is the shared universe of STUDIO N29's projects: characters, factions and places that connect from one game to the next.
s.apex.p2: Heroes Dawn is its first big chapter, set in a world where humans have become metahumans. A new project, Hell Rising, has just entered conception.

s.manifesto: A good game gives you decisions that matter, in a world you want to stay in.
s.phil.title: How we design.
s.p1.d: Every mission begins with a choice. We design decisions the player can read, weigh and own, not just reflexes to react to.
s.p2.d: Players should always understand what is happening and why. Clear information and a clean interface come before spectacle.
s.p3.d: A mechanic is finished when it feels right in the hands, not merely when it works. We iterate until the sensation is there.
s.p4.d: Heroes are more than silhouettes: each one has their own powers and their own story.
s.p5.d: Our games share one universe, the Apex Universe. Characters, factions and places travel from one game to the next.
s.p6.d: We prefer a concentrated adventure with detours that matter over padding. Every hour must earn its place.
s.prac.title: The philosophy, in our games.
s.hd.title: Choices you can read.
s.hd.text: The combat timeline shows who acts next, so every decision is made with the full picture. Between missions, headquarters turns preparation into a part of the game.
s.hr.title: Power that feels good.
s.hr.text: Our new project starts from the sensation: fluid, powerful combat and a concentrated story. It is too early to say more.
lore.title: The world, in brief.
lore.lead: Heroes Dawn is set in the Apex Universe, the shared universe of STUDIO N29's games. Here is what you need to know before joining The Dawn.
lore.t1.d: In the middle of the Cold War, the United States creates the Apex Unit: the very first metahumans.
lore.t2.d: One night, a phenomenon strikes Paris. Across the world, people's genes are altered. For most, nothing changes; in some, a power lies dormant.
lore.t3.d: Powers awaken after a sudden shock. The world is torn between fear, fascination and hope, and institutions try to control the metahumans. You join The Dawn.
lore.c1.d: An organization founded by metahumans who chose not to hide. Its symbol is a golden four-pointed star. It protects metahumans and civilians.
lore.c2.d: An agency that claims to supervise metahumans for their safety, but studies and takes their abilities. The Dawn's main official threat.
lore.c3.d: The everyday nickname of metahumans, taken from the original Apex Unit. The official term remains “metahuman”.
